caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a woven seat positioned within a faint rectangular border on a plain, lightly yellowed background. The chair has four rounded legs, each featuring turned detailing, and two armrests attached to the front legs. There are two horizontal slats forming the backrest, with rounded finials topping each of the back posts. The seat is square-shaped and constructed from woven material, colored in shades of beige and light green. The entire frame of the chair is a medium brown wood tone, and the chair casts a light shadow to the lower left. No other objects or elements are visible in the drawing.
title: High Chair
